source: nflverse play-by-play: 2023-2025 completed seasons (captured 2026-07-29) plus 2026 regular-season Weeks 1-2 only (32 games, captured 2026-09-26). A partial week is never encoded (see data.coverage).
note: Regular season only, plays with a down (excludes kickoffs/XPs/etc). Per-season tables use a 200-dropback minimum for QBs; the pooled table uses 500. 2026 covers Weeks 1-2 ONLY (32 games) — a small sample of two games per team, dominated by noise, opponent and game script; its QB minimum is the 200 bar prorated to 24 dropbacks. The pooled table spans every season in the snapshot, including the partial one. These are descriptive aggregates, not projections — team EPA is famously unstable year to year, so do not read 2025 as 2026, and do not read two weeks of 2026 as a season.

field_notes.off_epa_play: offensive EPA per play (higher is better)
field_notes.def_epa_play: EPA per play allowed (LOWER is better — sign is not flipped)
field_notes.cpoe: completion percentage over expected, percentage points

2026.note: nflverse play_by_play_2026.csv.gz (release updated 2026-09-25 14:36 UTC). Regular season Weeks 1-2 only (32 games); Week 3 was 1 of 16 games (2026_03_ATL_GB) and is excluded as incomplete.

tier_meaning: Working Dawg — earned its collar. Evidence survived validation: receipts against a benchmark chosen in advance for forecasters, named sources and reproducible maths for measurement tools.
